text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tracen Meet has arrived,
and visitors are pouring in
from across
campus and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for our race! I've been so excited for this! And I'm definitely gonna beat you, so get ready. ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'll see about that. Just you wait,
I'll catch you out there.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you have any idea who she is? The
one talking to Falco over
there.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No clue, but if the Smart Falcon sees her as a rival? That means she might be one to watch out for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A playful challenge from Smart Falcon,
who is currently unrivaled on
dirt, draws
attention to the as-yet-unknown Wonder
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully the pressure doesn't get to her.
Nerves can stiffen the body, restricting
range of movement and ultimately
affecting running
form.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would you mind? That'd be wonderful,
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she doesn't look particularly
nervous, her shoulders definitely
feel stiff.
I begin to gently tap on them with my
fists, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What's this, a shoulder massage? Why,
thank you. Don't go easy on my account,
though. It'd perk me right up if you put a
little oomph
into it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess a weak massage isn't going to
relieve any tension in the body
or mind. I
put some more strength—and heart—into
each hit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Yes, that's more like it! Now I'm all
fired up and ready to get
that win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're blessed with clear skies for our
tenth race, a 2,000-meter on
dirt. They're
all lined up in the gate... and here's the
start!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Off to an excellent start as always is
Smart
Falcon. She shoots to the
front like an
arrow!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
This is a runner who can fly away with a
lead. Let the gap grow too
big, and it'll be
impossible to close it later on.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hrryahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Holy smokes! The dirt really is Falco's
domain! No way anyone's
catching up to
her!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But look...
see that one runner still hanging
on? Wait, we saw her earlier, the one who
looked like she had her head in the
clouds!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I won't lose...
I won't be knocked down...
I'll show that here!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up, is she nuts?! A pre-debut
runner trying to keep pace
with Falco is
bound to end in disaster.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but she is locked in... I mean, it's crazy she can even match that speed in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I can do this... Trainer taught me all I
need to know, with patience
and
sincerity... And it all pays off—now!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You should stretch your right leg a bit
more.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (You would never see all of us runners as one and the same. You saw me for me, looked me straight in the eye...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thank your own tenacity—it's your secret
weapon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thank your own tenacity—it's your secret
weapon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(You saw things I never noticed, showed
me a strength I never knew I
had. You
honed it with me, so it would be my secret
weapon.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(You are... the most incredible person...
and if you can't see that, then
I'll show
you.)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...You're still keeping up. You really
trained hard for this, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But sorry, 'cause Falco here... is just
getting started!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're past the final corner and into
the stretch. Smart Falcon's
lead only grows
and grows—she's flying home!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute might be done! Little by
little, the gap is widening!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, it's over. But she held on for so
long!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Why are you surprised? It's Falco she's up
against! If anything, it's wild
that a
pre-debut runner was able to keep up as
long as she did.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is already over in the eyes of
the crowd around me. I don't blame them.
Wonder Acute is a no-name student who
hasn't even
debuted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I alone know her tenacity, her strength
that enables her to go to
endless lengths
for the sake of others... her passion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You betcha!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up! I won't be knocked down!
I'll run... till the very end!
Hahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes! Wonder Acute finds a
new gear! With the last of her
strength,
she bears down on Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't believe my eyes.
Are we really
seeing this caliber of
performance from a
pre-debut runner?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a miracle spurt is Wonder
Acute! Can she do it? Who'll it
be?! It's
Falcon! It's Acute! It's gonna be...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (The crowd goes wild!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's run in the Tracen Meet
ends in narrow defeat.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry about today. I just
couldn't pull through in the end.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought I could beat Falco and
give you a nice little boost
in confidence,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dogged fight she gave down the
stretch was something we fostered
together. After seeing that, I can't call
myself unfit to be a
trainer anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the two of them crossed the finish
line nearly neck and neck,
amidst the roar
of the crowd I heard someone say...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She lost... but, wow. I think she inspired
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her unfaltering pursuit warmed people's
hearts. If she knew that, I'm
sure it'd give
her the courage to do it time and time
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I've seen how far she can push herself
for others' sakes. Overexertion could
knock her to the ground one day—unless
she has
someone to lean on.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You mean to say... you'd be willing to
stay on as my trainer, is
that it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, I'd just as soon be the one asking
you. You really do like
underselling
yourself, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I hope to see you at training
tomorrow. And don't you worry, I won't
bend or break so easily, so be as tough as
you like, you
hear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She chuckles as if she's just joking
around, but I know her well enough
by now to see
the fighting spirit smoldering in those
gentle eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some things can only be found at the end
of a long and arduous road. With Wonder
Acute by my side,
I know we'll get there in
due time.
